name: 日常寒暄
blurb: 和外国人打招呼、闲聊、吃饭应酬：每天都用得上，最容易先开口的一组。

scenes.title: 好久不见，问声近况
scenes.situation: 在电梯里碰到一个好久没见的外国同行。打个招呼，说你最近挺忙，再问问他怎么样。
scenes.model: Hey, long time no see! How have you been? Things have been pretty hectic on my end. What about you?

scenes.title: 聊天气打开话题
scenes.situation: 开会前大家在等人。你随口聊聊天气：这周一直下雨，希望周末能放晴。
scenes.model: Can you believe this weather? It's been raining all week. Hopefully it'll clear up by the weekend.

scenes.title: 周末过得怎么样
scenes.situation: 周一早上，问同事周末过得怎么样，有没有出去玩；再说说你带孩子去了公园。
scenes.model: How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun? I just took the kids to the park. It was nice to get some fresh air.

scenes.title: 接住别人的夸奖
scenes.situation: 有人夸你刚才的发言讲得好。谢谢他，说其实你挺紧张的，再问问他哪部分最有用。
scenes.model: Thanks, that means a lot. To be honest, I was pretty nervous. Which part did you find most useful?

scenes.title: 礼貌地结束聊天
scenes.situation: 聊得挺开心，但你得去开个电话会了。礼貌地结束，说回头再聊。
scenes.model: Sorry, I have to jump on a call. It was really nice chatting with you. Let's catch up later.

scenes.title: 请外国客人吃饭
scenes.situation: 外国客户来上海出差。你想请他明晚吃饭，顺便问问他有没有不吃的东西。
scenes.model: Are you free tomorrow evening? I'd love to take you out for dinner. Is there anything you don't eat?

chunks.en: Is there anything you don't eat?

scenes.title: 给客人推荐一道菜
scenes.situation: 饭桌上，你给外国客人推荐红烧肉：本地人最爱，有点甜，很多人第一次吃就喜欢上了。
scenes.model: You should try the braised pork. It's a local favorite. It's a little sweet, and most people love it the first time they try it.

scenes.title: 举杯说一句
scenes.situation: 年底饭局，你举杯感谢大家这一年的合作，祝明年更好。
scenes.model: I'd like to propose a toast. Thank you all for a great year working together. Here's to an even better one next year! Cheers!

scenes.title: 抢着买单
scenes.situation: 吃完饭对方要付钱。你坚持这顿你来，他是客人，下次再让他请。
scenes.model: No, no, this one's on me. You're our guest. You can get the next one.

scenes.title: 先走一步
scenes.situation: 饭后大家要去第二场，你明早有会，想先回去，祝他们玩得开心。
scenes.model: Thanks, but I think I'll call it a night. I have an early meeting tomorrow. You guys have fun!

chunks.zh: 今天就到这儿（先回去了）

plays.title: 酒会上和陌生人聊
plays.setup: 行业酒会上，一位叫 Emma 的美国人站在你旁边，你们手里都端着酒杯。
plays.goal: 从寒暄聊到彼此的工作，最后加个联系方式。
plays.persona: You are Emma, an American marketing consultant at an industry networking reception in Shanghai. You are warm and curious. Make small talk, ask about the other person's work, share a little about yours, and if the conversation goes well, happily exchange contact details.
plays.opener: Hi there! This place is packed tonight, isn't it?

plays.title: 外国朋友第一次来上海
plays.setup: Tom 是你的外国朋友，第一次来上海，周末有两天空，想让你推荐。
plays.goal: 推荐两个地方和一道菜，说清怎么去。
plays.persona: You are Tom, a friendly British visitor in Shanghai for the first time, with a free weekend. Ask your local friend for places to go and food to try. Ask simple follow-up questions like how to get there and whether it's crowded.
plays.opener: So I've got the whole weekend free. Where should I go first?
